definition_en: Mass of thermoplastic melt extruded through a standard die in a plastometer at a specified temperature and load, stated in g/10 min and used as a simple measure of flowability.
term_ja: メルトマスフローレイト
variants_ja: メルトフローレイト;メルトフローインデックス;メルトインデックス
ng_ja: メルトボリュームフローレイト
ng_note: 「メルトボリュームフローレイト」（日本語）、「熔体体积流动速率」（中国語）、「Schmelze-Volumenfließrate」（ドイツ語）、「índice de fluidez en volumen」（スペイン語）は押し出された体積で表す MVR（cm³/10 min）の名称で、質量で表す MFR（g/10 min）とは別の値。
source_ref: ISO 1133-1 Plastics — Determination of the melt mass-flow rate (MFR) and melt volume-flow rate (MVR) of thermoplastics — Part 1: Standard method; ASTM D1238 Standard Test Method for Melt Flow Rates of Thermoplastics by Extrusion Plastometer

definition_en: Fluid whose viscosity depends on shear rate or shear history; polymer melts are non-Newtonian and their viscosity falls as shear rate rises.
source_ref: Dealy & Wissbrun, Melt Rheology and Its Role in Plastics Processing, Springer

definition_en: Colorant that dissolves in the polymer and gives transparent coloring, unlike an insoluble pigment; used mainly in amorphous, transparent plastics.
ng_note: 「顔料」（日本語）・「颜料」（中国語）・「안료」（韓国語）・「Pigment」（ドイツ語）・「pigmento」（スペイン語）は樹脂に溶けない粒子状の着色剤で、樹脂に溶ける染料とは別の概念。
source_ref: Charvat (ed.), Coloring of Plastics: Fundamentals and Colorants, 2nd ed., Wiley

definition_en: Volume or mass of resin that the hopper of an injection molding machine, dryer or loader can hold, stated in its specification.
source_ref: Kawata: autoloader VL series product information (public); Johannaber, Injection Molding Machines: A User's Guide, 4th ed. (Hanser, 2008)

definition_en: Water content left in plastic pellets after drying, usually stated in percent by mass and compared with the resin supplier's maximum allowable value for molding.
source_ref: Polyplastics: technical solutions (POM, PBT, PPS, LCP) public technical pages

definition_en: Size-reduction machine with knives on a rotor cutting against fixed bed knives above a screen, used to turn sprues, runners and rejected parts into regrind for reuse.
ng_note: 「造粒机」（中国語）は樹脂をペレットにする造粒機（ペレタイザー）を指し、スプルー・ランナーや不良品を砕いて粉砕材にする粉砕機とは別の機械。
source_ref: EN 12012-1 Plastics and rubber machines — Size reduction machines — Part 1: Safety requirements for blade granulators

definition_en: Molded part sorted out because it fails inspection or process monitoring limits, to be scrapped, reground or reworked.
ng_note: 「返品」（日本語）、「退货」（中国語）、「반품」（韓国語）は顧客から返された出荷品の意で、工程で選別した不良成形品には使わない。
source_ref: Rosato, Rosato & Rosato, Injection Molding Handbook, 3rd ed., Springer; Goodship, Troubleshooting Injection Moulding, Rapra Review Report (Rapra Technology, 2004)

definition_en: Hydraulic cylinder on the injection unit whose piston pushes the screw forward to inject the melt and hold pressure on it.
ng_note: 「加熱シリンダ」（日本語）、「料筒」（中国語）、「가열 실린더」（韓国語）、「Plastifizierzylinder」（ドイツ語）は樹脂を溶かすバレルを指し、スクリュを前進させる油圧シリンダとは別の部品。
source_ref: F. Johannaber, Injection Molding Machines: A User's Guide, 4th ed., Hanser (2008)

definition_en: Filling the cavity at a very high injection speed, typically for thin-wall parts, using an accumulator-assisted hydraulic or a high-response electric injection unit.
ng_note: 「ハイサイクル成形」（日本語）はサイクルタイムを短くする成形の総称で、射出速度を高くすることを指す語ではない。
source_ref: Osswald, Turng, Gramann (eds.), Injection Molding Handbook, 2nd ed. (Hanser, 2008)

definition_en: Set or actual forward speed of the screw during the filling phase, in mm/s, often profiled in stages; it determines the melt flow rate into the cavity.
ng_note: 「噴射速度」（日本語）、「喷射速度」（中国語）、「분사 속도」（韓国語）は燃料噴射や噴霧の速度を指す語で、射出成形のスクリュ前進速度には使わない。
source_ref: ISO 294-1 Plastics — Injection moulding of test specimens of thermoplastic materials — Part 1: General principles

definition_en: Force with which the clamping unit holds the mold halves closed against the opening force of the cavity pressure; the rated maximum is used to size the machine.
ng_note: 「型開力」（日本語）、「开模力」（中国語）、「형개력」（韓国語）、「Öffnungskraft」（ドイツ語）、「fuerza de apertura」（スペイン語）は金型を開くときに可動盤を引き離す力で、金型を閉じて保持する型締力とは別の量。「Spannkraft」（ドイツ語）は治具やチャックで工作物を締め付ける力を指し、成形機の型締力には「Schließkraft」を使う。
source_ref: ISO 472 Plastics — Vocabulary; GB/T 25156 Rubber and plastics injection moulding machines — General technical conditions; F. Johannaber, Injection Molding Machines: A User's Guide, 4th ed., Hanser (2008); D. M. Bryce, Plastic Injection Molding: Manufacturing Process Fundamentals, SME (1996)

definition_en: Hydraulic valve that opens, closes or switches oil flow paths, for example a 4/3-way solenoid valve, to drive the clamp, injection or ejector cylinders forward and back.
source_ref: ISO 1219-1 Fluid power systems and components — Graphical symbols and circuit diagrams — Part 1

definition_en: Half of the mold mounted on the fixed platen at the nozzle side, which usually contains the sprue bushing and does not move during the cycle.
ng_note: 日本語「固定盤」は成形機側の固定プラテンを指す別概念で、金型の固定側半分ではない。
source_ref: F. Johannaber, Injection Molding Machines: A User's Guide, 4th ed., Hanser (2008); Menges G., Michaeli W., Mohren P., How to Make Injection Molds, 3rd ed., Hanser (2001)

definition_en: Operating mode in which each machine movement, such as mold closing, injection, screw rotation or ejection, runs only when the operator presses the corresponding key; used for setup and troubleshooting.
source_ref: Johannaber, Injection Molding Machines: A User's Guide, 4th ed. (Hanser, 2008); F. Johannaber, Injection Molding Machines: A User's Guide, 4th ed., Hanser (2008)

definition_en: Taking the molded parts out of the open mold after ejection, either by hand, by letting them fall freely or with a take-out robot.
variants_ja: 製品取出し;成形品の取り出し
ng_note: 「部品除去」（日本語）・「零件去除」（中国語）は removal を「除去・去除」と訳した直訳で、不要部分を取り除く意味に読まれる。成形品を型から取り出す動作には使わない。
source_ref: Johannaber, Injection Molding Machines: A User's Guide, 4th ed. (Hanser)

definition_en: Thin outer layer of an injection-molded part that solidifies first against the cold mold wall and retains high molecular or fiber orientation from the fountain flow.
ng_note: 「皮膚層」（日本語）・「皮肤层」（中国語）・「피부층」（韓国語）は skin（皮膚）の直訳で、成形品の表層の意味では使われない。
source_ref: Osswald, Turng, Gramann (eds.), Injection Molding Handbook, 2nd ed. (Hanser, 2008)

definition_en: Molding defect in which the melt does not completely fill the cavity, leaving the part with missing sections, typically at the end of flow or in thin areas.
variants_ja: 充填不足;充てん不足;未充填;ショート
ng_note: 「短いショット」（日本語）・「짧은 샷」（韓国語）・「kurzer Schuss」（ドイツ語）は short shot の直訳で、キャビティが充填されきらない成形不良を表さない。
source_ref: Goodship, Troubleshooting Injection Moulding, Rapra Review Report (Rapra Technology, 2004)

definition_en: Line or notch on a molded part where two melt fronts meet and fuse, for example behind a hole or between two gates; it is often visible and mechanically weaker.
variants_ja: ウエルドライン;ニットライン
ng_note: 「溶接線」(JA)・「焊缝」(ZH)は金属などの溶接継手の意で、成形品で流動先端が合流してできる線を指さない。
source_ref: ISO 472 Plastics — Vocabulary; JIS K 6900 プラスチック—用語; Rosato, Rosato, Rosato, Injection Molding Handbook, 3rd ed. (Kluwer Academic, 2000)

definition_en: Warpage in which a molded part rotates about its own long axis so that its ends no longer lie in the same plane.
source_ref: Fischer, Handbook of Molded Part Shrinkage and Warpage, 2nd ed. (Elsevier, 2013)

definition_en: Approved part kept as the reference against which production parts are compared for appearance, color or dimensions.
ng_note: 「限度見本」、中国語「限度样品」、韓国語「한도 견본」、ドイツ語「Grenzmuster」、スペイン語「muestra límite」は合否の境界（許容限度）を示す見本で、基準となる良品見本（マスターサンプル）とは別。
source_ref: AIAG Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) reference manual

definition_en: Tool, usually of steel, that contains one or more cavities together with feed, temperature-control and ejection systems, in which the material is shaped and solidified.
ng_note: 「カビ」（日本語）、「霉菌」（中国語）、「곰팡이」（韓国語）、「Schimmel」（ドイツ語）、「moho」（スペイン語）は菌類のかびの意で、成形用の型ではない（mould の機械翻訳で起こる誤り）。
source_ref: ISO 472 (Plastics — Vocabulary); JIS K 6900 プラスチック—用語; Pye R.G.W., Injection Mould Design, 4th ed., Longman (1989)

definition_en: Mold whose runner system is kept molten, usually by a hot runner, so that no solidified runner is ejected with the parts.
source_ref: Rees H., Mold Engineering, 2nd ed., Hanser (2002)

definition_en: Triangular rib that joins a wall, boss or flange to an adjacent surface to stiffen it without adding much wall thickness.
ng_note: 日本語「マチ」は袋や衣服に幅を持たせるための布（gusset）の意味で、成形品の三角リブには使わない。
source_ref: Malloy R.A., Plastic Part Design for Injection Molding, Hanser (1994)

definition_en: Edge gate that widens like a fan from the runner towards the part, usually with decreasing depth, so that the melt enters along a wide front with less jetting, orientation and warpage in flat parts.
ng_note: 「风扇浇口」（中国語）は fan を送風機の「风扇」と訳した誤訳で、扇形に広がるゲートを表さない。
source_ref: Beaumont J.P., Runner and Gating Design Handbook, 2nd ed., Hanser (2007)

definition_en: Gate fed from a ring-shaped runner surrounding a core, entering the cavity around its full circumference; used for tubular parts to avoid weld lines.
source_ref: Beaumont J.P., Runner and Gating Design Handbook, 2nd ed., Hanser (2007); JIS K 6900 プラスチック—用語

definition_en: Cross-sectional dimensions of a gate (diameter, or width and depth) together with its land length, which control shear, pressure drop, freeze-off time and gate vestige.
ng_note: 中国語「门尺寸」、ドイツ語「Torgröße」、スペイン語「tamaño de la puerta」は gate を出入口の門・扉と訳した誤りで、金型のゲートを表さない。
source_ref: Beaumont J.P., Runner and Gating Design Handbook, 2nd ed., Hanser (2007)

definition_en: Liquid, normally water or oil, pumped through the cooling channels of a mold to remove heat from the molded part.
ng_note: 中国語「切削液」、韓国語「절삭유」は工作機械の切削油剤を指し、金型内を流れる冷却媒体には使わない。
source_ref: Kazmer, Injection Mold Design Engineering (Hanser, textbook); Menges, Michaeli & Mohren, How to Make Injection Molds (Hanser, textbook)

definition_en: Letting air and volatile gases escape from the cavity as the melt fills it, through shallow vent grooves, parting-line vents, porous inserts or ejector clearances, to prevent burn marks and short shots.
ng_note: 日本語「換気」、中国語「通风」、韓国語「환기」、ドイツ語「Lüftung」は室内の空気の入れ替えを指し、金型キャビティからのガス抜きには使わない。
source_ref: Menges, Michaeli & Mohren, How to Make Injection Molds (Hanser, textbook)

definition_en: Temperature of the molded part, at its surface or averaged through the wall, during cooling in the mold and after ejection; simulation uses it to judge whether the part can be ejected.
source_ref: Autodesk Moldflow public help documentation (cool analysis)

definition_en: Cold working of a metal surface by bombarding it with small steel or ceramic balls, used on mold and machine parts to induce compressive residual stress and improve fatigue and crack resistance.
ng_note: 「ショットブラスト」（日本語）、「쇼트 블라스트」（韓国語）は投射材を当てて表面の清浄化や粗面化を行う別の処理（shot blasting）で、圧縮残留応力を与えて疲労強度を高めるショットピーニングとは目的が異なる。
source_ref: ISO 2080 Metallic and other inorganic coatings — Surface treatment, metallic and other inorganic coatings — Vocabulary

definition_en: Maintenance in which a mold or machine is repaired only after a failure has occurred, as opposed to preventive or predictive maintenance.
source_ref: Rees & Catoen, Selecting Injection Molds (Hanser, textbook)

definition_en: Sudden locking of sliding or rotating mold parts, such as slides, ejector pins or cores, when their surfaces weld together because of insufficient clearance, lubrication or hardness.
ng_note: 「差押え」（日本語）、「扣押」（中国語）、「압류」（韓国語）、「Beschlagnahme」（ドイツ語）、「embargo」（スペイン語）は法律上の差押え（seizure）の訳で、摺動部品の焼付きの意味はない。
source_ref: Rees & Catoen, Selecting Injection Molds (Hanser, textbook)

definition_en: Collective term for the molds and associated fixtures, gauges and end-of-arm tools needed to produce a given part, as budgeted and owned in a project.
ng_note: 「工具」（中国語）は手工具や刃物などの道具を指し、製品の生産に必要な金型・治具一式（工装模具）を指さない。
source_ref: Rees & Catoen, Selecting Injection Molds (Hanser, textbook)

definition_en: Enclosing a component such as a coil, sensor or electronic assembly completely in plastic by molding around it, to seal and protect it.
ng_note: 「ポッティング」（日本語）、「灌封」（中国語）、「포팅」（韓国語）は液状樹脂をケースなどに流し込んで硬化させる注型の工程（potting）を指し、成形による封入とは別の工程。
source_ref: Osswald, Turng & Gramann (eds.), Injection Molding Handbook (Hanser)

definition_en: Unit that separates nitrogen from compressed air by membrane or pressure-swing adsorption to supply gas for gas-assist injection or physical foaming.
source_ref: Osswald, Turng & Gramann (eds.), Injection Molding Handbook (Hanser)

definition_en: Step in metal or ceramic injection molding that removes most of the binder from the molded green part by solvent, catalytic or thermal treatment before sintering.
ng_note: ドイツ語「Entfettung」・スペイン語「desengrase」は日本語・中国語の「脱脂」を油分を除く脱脂（degreasing）と取り違えた訳で、成形体からバインダーを除く工程には「Entbindern」「eliminación del ligante」を使う。
source_ref: German & Bose, Injection Molding of Metals and Ceramics (MPIF)

definition_en: Machine with two horizontal counter-rotating rolls, often at different speeds and temperatures, on which polymer compounds are masticated, mixed or sheeted in the open nip; a serious entrapment hazard.
variants_ja: ミキシングロール;オープンロール
ng_note: 中国語「双辊轧机」は金属を圧延する二重圧延機を指し、ゴムや樹脂を混練する2本ロール機（开炼机）ではない。
source_ref: EN 1417 Plastics and rubber machines — Two roll mills — Safety requirements

definition_en: Unit downstream of the extruder and cooling section, usually with belts or caterpillar tracks or rolls, that pulls the extrudate at a controlled constant speed and so sets its final dimensions.
source_ref: EN 1114-3 Plastics and rubber machines — Extruders and extrusion lines — Part 3: Safety requirements for haul-offs

definition_en: Machine with several heated, precisely gapped rolls through which a plasticized compound is passed to form film or sheet of controlled thickness.
ng_note: 「日历」（中国語）・「달력」（韓国語）・「Kalender」（ドイツ語）・「calendario」（スペイン語）は暦（カレンダー）の意の誤訳で、ロールでシートを成形する機械には使わない。
source_ref: EN 12301 Plastics and rubber machines — Calenders — Safety requirements

definition_en: Load-bearing capacity of a welded joint between thermoplastic parts, determined for example by tensile pull-off, burst or peel testing and often compared with the strength of the base material.
ng_es: resistencia de la línea de soldadura
ng_note: 「ウェルド強度」（日本語）・「熔接痕强度」（中国語）・「웰드라인 강도」（韓国語）・「Bindenahtfestigkeit」（ドイツ語）・「resistencia de la línea de soldadura」（スペイン語）は射出成形品のウェルドライン部の強度を指し、部品同士を溶着した接合部の強度とは別の概念。
source_ref: Troughton, Handbook of Plastics Joining: A Practical Guide, 2nd ed. (William Andrew/PDL)

definition_en: Manual or semi-automatic welding of thermoplastic sheet, film and pipe in which a stream of hot air or nitrogen softens the joint surfaces, usually with a filler rod of the same plastic pressed in; lap welding of films and membranes needs no rod.
source_ref: Grewell, Benatar, Park (eds.), Plastics and Composites Welding Handbook (Hanser); JIS K 6900 プラスチック—用語

definition_en: Surface treatment in which an oxidizing gas flame briefly sweeps a polyolefin part, raising its surface energy for painting, printing or bonding.
ng_note: 「難燃処理」（日本語）・「阻燃处理」（中国語）・「난연 처리」（韓国語）・「tratamiento ignífugo」（スペイン語）は燃えにくくする処理で、炎で表面を酸化して濡れ性を上げる前処理とは別の概念。
source_ref: Vetaphone: corona and plasma surface treatment (public technical pages)

definition_en: In SMED, changeover work that can only be done while the molding machine is stopped, such as unclamping and removing the old mold and clamping the new one.
ng_note: 「内部設定」（日本語）・「内部设置」（中国語）・「내부 설정」（韓国語）・「configuración interna」（スペイン語）は setup を「設定」と取った直訳で、機器の内部の設定（構成）と読まれ、機械を止めて行う段取り作業を表さない。
source_ref: Shingo, A Revolution in Manufacturing: The SMED System (Productivity Press)

definition_en: Changeover work done while the machine is still producing, such as preheating the next mold and preparing tools, as opposed to internal setup.
ng_note: 「外部設定」（日本語）・「外部设置」（中国語）・「외부 설정」（韓国語）・「configuración externa」（スペイン語）は setup を「設定」と取った直訳で、外部の設定（構成）と読まれ、機械の稼働中に行う段取り作業を表さない。
source_ref: Shingo, A Revolution in Manufacturing: The SMED System (Productivity Press)

definition_en: Camera-based inspection system with lighting and image-processing software that checks parts automatically for presence, dimensions, defects or codes.
source_ref: KEYENCE: machine vision systems and code readers (public technical pages)

definition_en: Theoretically exact reference, established from a real feature of the part, to which geometrical tolerances of location or orientation are related; in molding it fixes how the part is held for measurement.
ng_note: 「数据」（中国語）・「데이터」（韓国語）は data の訳で、幾何公差の基準ではない。ドイツ語の「Datum」は日付の意味。
source_ref: ISO 5459 Geometrical product specifications (GPS) — Geometrical tolerancing — Datums and datum systems

definition_en: Network of finite elements, such as triangles or tetrahedra, into which a part and mold model are divided for filling, cooling and warpage simulation; mesh type and density affect accuracy and run time.
source_ref: Autodesk Moldflow Insight help: analysis types, mesh types and result descriptions (public documentation)

definition_en: Plastic made wholly or partly from carbon of renewable biological origin, such as plant-derived monomers, irrespective of whether it is biodegradable.
term_ja: バイオベースプラスチック
variants_ja: バイオマスプラスチック
ng_ja: 生分解性プラスチック
ng_note: 「生分解性プラスチック」（日本語）・「生物降解塑料」（中国語）・「생분해성 플라스틱」（韓国語）・「biologisch abbaubarer Kunststoff」（ドイツ語）・「plástico biodegradable」（スペイン語）は分解性による分類で、原料がバイオマス由来かどうかとは別。生分解しないバイオベースプラスチックもある。
source_ref: EN 16575 Bio-based products — Vocabulary; Japan BioPlastics Association (JBPA): biomass plastic and biodegradable plastic identification systems (public)

definition_en: Waste with hazardous properties such as toxicity, flammability or ecotoxicity, for example used hydraulic oil, solvent residues or contaminated cleaning materials from a molding plant, which must be handled and disposed of under special rules.
source_ref: Directive 2008/98/EC on waste (Waste Framework Directive)

definition_en: Keeping different waste streams in a plant (for example clean regrind, contaminated purgings, packaging, oil-soaked rags) apart at the point where they arise so that each can be recycled or disposed of properly.
ng_note: 「隔離」（日本語）・「废物隔离」（中国語）は segregation の辞書訳で、隔離・封じ込めの意味に読まれ、廃棄物を種類別に分けることを表さない。
source_ref: Directive 2008/98/EC on waste (Waste Framework Directive)
